name: Closed-Form Scene Appearance Estimation
definition: A global least-squares problem to estimate spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients for mesh vertices, formulated as minimizing the weighted residual between observed pixel colors and predicted vertex contributions, regularized by adaptive SH penalties.
summary: Closed-Form Scene Appearance Estimation analytically solves for view-dependent spherical harmonic coefficients via a global weighted least-squares system, avoiding iterative optimization through adaptive regularization and a matrix-free solver.
